exposed.note: The exposed Cairn panel is an unauthenticated web service. Amazon does not name a host rule for the panel.

agents.note: Operator prompts and AI output were on the attacker panel. That is not victim-side telemetry.

failed.note: The Redis operation and the GPU-server password spray failed. The credential profile is the password spray, not a Redis rule.

traversal.note: MONAI Label upload path traversal is application HTTP. The generic web profile does not name those routes.

shell.note: The root shell started from a write to sitecustomize.py and a later Python process. Amazon does not name the operating system.

second.note: Amazon infers the operator already had a tunnel into a second university. The proxy itself was not recovered.
